title: Lead captured and qualified
summary: A visitor sends an enquiry to the client's lead form; it reaches the CRM and is qualified. The first leg of lead to cash, on the canary client. Runs every night: it creates no quote, invoice or approval.

steps.title: Find the canary client
steps.note: Asking again returns the same client. An empty leadForm.embed means the CRM page was never opened (the plugin does not know its public address yet): that is a failure to report, not something to fix by hand.

steps.title: Look at the lead form page
steps.note: This is the page a client's visitor sees. Take a desktop screenshot with pib-shot (references/screenshots.md: pib-shot <url> --json) and again with --viewport mobile. Report pib-shot's JSON line as output and attach each PNG path as screenshot evidence. If the page does not load, report pib-shot's own error as the error: it is a finding.

steps.title: Read how many enquiries the canary form has taken
Send one test enquiry to the form
steps.note: Run the curl once, but replace the example name and address first: use the email canary@canary.invalid and the message Acceptance run {{runId}}. Report the command you ran as input.curl and the answer as output {status, body}. Never use a real address.

steps.title: The form counts the enquiry
steps.note: Allow a few seconds after the enquiry; ask again once if the number has not moved.

input.body: Acceptance run {{runId}} (canary): enquiry read, need and budget confirmed.

steps.title: The lead issue the enquiry opened gets closed
steps.note: The enquiry opens a lead issue (title starts 'Lead for') and wakes its assignee, usually the Inbound Qualifier, who checks it out and works it for a few minutes. Do NOT set it done yourself and never break the other agent's checkout: the host refuses it, and the qualifier needs the canary records this run still holds until cleanup. Find the issue with the Paperclip API (open issues whose text mentions canary or Acceptance run {{runId}}), then poll it every 30 seconds for up to 5 minutes and report {issueId} as soon as it is done or cancelled. Only if no agent has it checked out and no run of its assignee is live, comment 'Closed by acceptance run {{runId}}: canary' and set it done yourself. Still open after 5 minutes: report its issueId anyway, so the check fails with the status it is in (the qualifier did not finish: a real finding). If there is none, report error: no lead issue (the CRM promises one). Cleanup is the next step and runs after this one, so do not report until the issue is closed or the 5 minutes are up.
